description: Verify that TCP in CLOSE-WAIT returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of UNACCEPTABLE_11/_12/_13 for CLOSE-WAIT (after passive-close FIN).

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each: handshake → tester FIN → DUT CLOSE-WAIT (close-wait ACK emitted). Then tester injects OTW-SEQ / unacc-ACK. DUT corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce corrective ACKs.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: handshake / close ACK / data ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked in CLOSE-WAIT (OTW + unacc) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in CLOSE-WAIT
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to unacceptable ACK in CLOSE-WAIT
